candidate_policy.active_selection: Only one template is active on the root route at a time.
candidate_policy.preview_rule: Candidate templates must be previewable without changing production active-template config.
candidate_policy.shared_content_rule: Every candidate renders the same shared src/data/site.json content unless a content-contract change is approved.
candidate_policy.privacy_rule: Privacy, analytics, direct links, and provider-backed data behavior must not change during template comparison.
candidate_policy.contract_rule: New candidate directions need a JSON design contract before implementation.

candidates.purpose: Most normal, trustworthy, and personal version of the root.
candidates.primary_question: Does this feel like an organized person instead of a tech presentation?
candidates.activation_test: Feels more trustworthy than link-index-mobile-first without becoming generic.

candidates.purpose: Root template that creates a stronger bridge into docs.jnap.me as the public garden/wiki.
candidates.primary_question: Does the root make the docs/wiki feel like the deeper public knowledge surface without overexplaining?
must_not_change: docs content stays off the root until governed
candidates.activation_test: Makes docs.jnap.me feel important without turning the root into a blog.

candidates.purpose: Hiring/professional proof-forward root focused on resume, docs, GitHub, and projects.
candidates.primary_question: Does this help a reviewer trust the work faster?
candidates.activation_test: Improves professional scan speed without making the page feel like a deck.

candidates.purpose: Curious personal front-room template that makes visitors want to click deeper without explaining everything.
candidates.primary_question: Does this make Justin feel interesting, human, and worth exploring while staying trustworthy?
changes: object-led route clusters instead of visible category headers
slightly less polished and more alive surface
motion allowed only as reduced-motion-safe curiosity and craft
candidates.activation_test: Beats the current template for curiosity and personal signal without becoming unclear or performative.

candidates.purpose: Warmer personal card style with stronger tactile identity.
candidates.primary_question: Can the root feel more personal and less interface-like while staying simple?
candidates.activation_test: Feels personal and polished without decorative clutter.

candidates.purpose: Text-forward index that treats the root like a durable personal directory.
candidates.primary_question: Does an even simpler text-led page feel more trustworthy?
candidates.activation_test: Feels clear and durable, not unfinished.

candidates.purpose: More personal/social presentation while avoiding embedded feeds.
candidates.primary_question: Can the root show personal texture safely without exposing private life?
changes: more emphasis on selected social exits

candidates.purpose: Reusable small-business/person template for future tenants.
candidates.primary_question: Can this become a reusable PR base without making Justin's root generic?
candidates.activation_test: Useful as a future tenant template, not necessarily the JNAP default.
